business.description: Twin Roses Trades & Agencies Limited is a listed company incorporated in 1985 with registered office in Mumbai. The company incurred a loss of Rs. 5.44 Lakhs in FY 2025-26.

products.name: general commodities
products.note: The Company is involved only in trading of general commodities and does not have segments.
